metaTitle: Hamilkar Barka (~275 – 229/228 send Ɛisa) — Lebraq n Qarṭaǧ
metaDesc: Hamilkar Barka : ur yettwanyif ara di Sicile (Heircté, Éryx), amenyaf deg umenɣi n yimirsinariyen ɣer tɣuyit n Scie, amenyaf n Hispanya, baba-s n Hanibal akked bab n limin mgal Ṛuma.
title: Hamilkar Barka
epithet: Barka, « Lebraq » — amenyaf n umenɣi ur yettwanyif ara, baba-s n tegelda
lede: Ur yettwanyif ara di Sicile, amselkem n Qarṭaǧ deg umenɣi n yimirsinariyen, abennan n tgelda tamaynut di Hispanya : argaz-nni i igan seg uɣelli-ines allal n tririt — i yesgallan mmi-s Hanibal ur ad yili d amddakel n Ṛuma abeda.
stats.0.t: n umenɣi di Sicile (247–241) war ma yettwanyif
stats.1.t: d kuẓ wagguren n umenɣi « ur yettwasemmeḥ ara » mgal yimirsinariyen (Polybe)
stats.2.t: imirsinariyen ițwaneqḍen deg uɣelluy n Scie, akken i d-yeqqar Polybe
stats.3.t: n tnayaf di Hispanya (237–229/228) ; d ṣṣeḥ-ines daɣen n Hanibal deg wass n limin
chrono.title: Tudert deg mraw n wussan
chrono.rows.0.d: Deg twacult tanaẓurt taqarṭaǧit. Isem-is wis sin, Barka, i d-yekkan, ammas, seg wawal apuni baraq, « lebraq ».
chrono.rows.1.d: Yettusemma d anezwi n lɛesker ipuniyen di Sicile, yers-ed ɣer tama n Panormos (Palerme) yezdeɣ ɣef wedrar n Heircté. Deg useggas-nni, i d-ilul mmi-s Hanibal.
chrono.rows.2.d: Seg lqelɛa-agi n tnefsut, yeggar lɛesker Iṛumaniyen di Sicile, yettazen daɣen lbabura-ines ɣer tama n usamer n Italya.
chrono.rows.3.d: Yeṭṭef s telɣa tamdint n Éryx, i gellan ger snat n lɛesker Iṛumaniyen : yiwen deg uqerru d wayeḍ ddaw-as, yeqqim din armi d tagara n umenɣi.
chrono.rows.4.d: Ass n 10 meɣres, lbabura n tallalt tipuniyen ttwahudment sɣur Lutatius Catulus. Yettwaklef ad imeslay, Hamilkar yugi ad yefk leslaḥ-is : talwit tḥesseb Sicile akked 3200 n ttalan deg mraw iseggasen.
chrono.rows.5.d: Iɛeskriyen ur ittwaxelṣen ara kkren-d, dukklen-d yid-sen tudrin tilibikiyen. Yuɣal-d Hamilkar ɣer taɛessast, yeḥṛes-iten deg uɣelluy n Scie, imbeɛd zdat Tunes.
chrono.rows.6.d: Tḥulfa Ṛuma s wannect-nni n lawan, teṭṭef Sardaigne tessuter-d ugar n 1200 n ttalan. Ssexsar-agi yeẓẓa cci deg At Barka.
chrono.rows.7.d: Yewweḍ ɣer Hispanya akked mmi-s Hanibal, yesɛa ṭsaɛ iseggasen, akked yiri-s Hasdrubal. Send ad ṣuffen, Hanibal yegall limin-is.
chrono.rows.8.d: Ittaɛ agdud n Turdétans akked wagduden n usamer, yeṭṭef lmɛadin n nnuqra, yesers tamdint n Akra Leukè. Deg 231, yerra-d i ibaɛɛaten iṛumaniyen belli yettnaɣ iwakken ad yexleṣ asamger i Ṛuma (Dion Cassius).
chrono.rows.9.d: Yettwaxdeɛ sɣur agellid n Orissi deg lweqt n uḥebbes n Héliké, yemmut deg wasif mi gḥadar tazzla n warraw-is. Yiri-s Hasdrubal i t-id-iqeblen.
sicily.title: Lebraq n Sicile
sicily.aside: Heircté (247–244), imbeɛd Éryx (244–241) : sebɛa iseggasen n umenɣi uffir deg tegzirt qrib akk taṛumanit.
sicily.paras.0: Deg umenɣi-ines meṛṛa di Sicile, Hamilkar Barka werǧin yettwanyif deg umenɣi. Yesselmed tasenɛet n umenɣi uffir, yesseɣli lxṣaṛa tiwɛirin ɣef lɛesker iṛumaniyen yeḥrez tazmert-is s telqey.
sicily.paras.1: Seg imukan n leḥras deg idurar — adrar n Heircté sennig Palerme, imbeɛd Éryx ɣer ugmar n tegzirt —, yettazen-d tiɛessasin s tezmert ɣef imukan iṛumaniyen d ubrid n lqut-nsen, lawan i t-id-yessexrab lbabur-is tama n Bruttium. Tirrayin-is gan taṭṭfa n Sicile sɣur Ṛuma d tin ur neshil ara, s idammen aṭas, sḥettment Ṛuma ad tḥebbes lɛesker meṛṛa akken kan ad ṭṭfen imukan-nsen.
sicily.paras.2: Polybe, ɣas akken yura s tmuɣli taṛumanit, yettwali deg-s anezwi aḥṛic n umenɣi meṛṛa, s tmusni akked tezmert n wul.
sicily.corr.label: Tiẓyiwin n umezruy
sicily.corr.title: Tamacahut n uɣelli di Sicile
sicily.corr.text: Aṭas n tikkal i d-qqaren d akken Hamilkar yettwasexleɛ seg Sicile. S tidet, ur yettwanyif ara mi gfukk umenɣi : yerra Sicile kan acku Qarṭaǧ texsar lbabur-is deg tegzirin n Égates, ur tezmir ara ad as-d-tazen lqut. Yettwaklef ad imeslay, yugi ad yefk leslaḥ-is, irgazen-is ffɣen-d seg tegzirt d iɛeskriyen, mačči d imeḥbas.
merc.title: Aselkem n Qarṭaǧ seg lɛesker-is s yiman-is
merc.intro: Mi d-uɣalen seg Sicile, azal n 20 000 n yimirsinariyen ssutren lexlaṣ-nsen. Qarṭaǧ, texsar s usamger, teɛṭṭel : tekker tkerrust, tedduklent yid-s tudrin tilibikiyen i yerran lɛya n ttrubiɛ. Tamdint tettwaḥbes deg wexxam-is, anezwi-ines amezwaru, Hanun, yerẓa. Ssutren-d Hamilkar.
merc.note: Polybe isemma i umenɣi-agi « ur yettwasemmeḥ ara » acku ayen i gedran dinna yewɛer aṭas. Flaubert yegra-t d amḍiq n Salammbô (1862).
merc.steps.0.d: Spendios, akli n Campanie i d-irewlen, akked Mathos, alibiki, ṭṭfen taɛessast n tkerrust ; Utique d Hippou Akra ttwaḥebsent.
merc.steps.1.d: S 10 000 n yirgazen d 70 n ilfilen, Hamilkar yezger asif ɣer tama n lebḥer s wemkan i d-ibeggen waḏu, yenyaf ikerrasen. Aqcic n ugellid anumidi Naravas yedda ɣer lɛesker-is s 2000 n yineggafen.
merc.steps.2.d: Ikerrasen gezmen, nɣan Giscon akked azal n 700 n imeḥbas iqarṭaǧiyen : seg imir-nni, ulac asemmeḥ ara d-yili ger yiḍfan-nniḍen.
merc.steps.3.d: Hamilkar yesserɣel lɛesker n Spendios deg uɣelluy n wedrar, Scie (Prion). Laẓ yewweḍ armi ttekkun gar-asen, ikerrasen azenen imeqdimen-nsen ad mselayen ; Hamilkar yeṭṭef-iten yeḥṛes lɛesker : ugar n 40 000 n lmut akken i d-yeqqar Polybe.
merc.steps.4.d: Spendios ittwasellab zdat Tunes. Mathos, yettwanyif deg umenɣi aneggaru, ittwaṭṭef ittwanɣa di Qarṭaǧ. Tamdint tettwaselkem — maca Ṛuma tḥulfa s lawan-nni tṭṭef Sardaigne.
iberia.title: Tagelda n Hispanya
iberia.aside: Txeṣṣer Sicile d Sardaigne, Qarṭaǧ tufa di Hispanya nnuqra, irgazen akked umsagar.
iberia.paras.0: Deg 237, Hamilkar yers-ed ɣer Gadès (Cadix), tamdint tafiniqit taqdimt. Deg ṭsaɛ iseggasen, s umenɣi d tsertit, yettaɛ agdud n Turdétans akked wagduden n usamer — Diodore yettbeddeṛ imeqdimen Istolatios d Indortès — yeṭṭef lmɛadin n nnuqra irẖisen n Sierra Morena.
iberia.paras.1: Dinna i gebna takeṛṛust n umenɣi n At Barka : lɛesker n ṣṣnaɛa, yesɛan talɣa, yeḥmel twacult n Barka am Senṭ n Qarṭaǧ. Tazmert-agi ad tuɣal d allal i wen-yekcem Hanibal Italya.
iberia.paras.2: Yesers Akra Leukè, « Ras Amellal » (iwakken ɣer tama n Alicante), yeg ṣṣerf n nnuqra yelhan aṭas. I ibaɛɛaten iṛumaniyen i d-yusan ad qelqen deg 231, yerra-d belli yettnaɣ Iberiyen iwakken ad yexleṣ ayen i tedyen Qarṭaǧ i Ṛuma.

iberia.wallCap: Lesswar tapunit n Carthagène (Qart Hadašt), tamdint i d-yesers yiri-s Hasdrubal ɣef lateg n tnayaf-is.

iberia.coin1Cap: Ssekel n At Barka ittwagen di Hispanya : alfil, acaraf n tezmert n umenɣi n At Barka.

iberia.coin2Cap: Ṛebɛ n ssekel n At Barka : nnuqra n lmɛadin iberiyen txelleṣ lɛesker d usamger i tedyen Qarṭaǧ i Ṛuma.
oath.cap: Limin n Hanibal, akken i t-id-iwala umesnulfu atrar
oath.title: Limin
oath.quote: « Baba, lawan ad iṣuffeɣ ɣer Iberiya akked lɛesker-is, yefka asfel. Yeqrib-iyi-d ɣer umnar, isres afus-iw ɣef lḥiwan n usfel, yesgall-iyi ur ad iliɣ d amddakel n Iṛumaniyen abeda. »
oath.cite: Hanibal i ugellid Antiochos, akken i d-yeqqar Polybe, Imezruyen, III, 11
oath.text: Tite-Live yettales-d lḥala-agi (XXI, 1) : aqcic, yesɛa ṭsaɛ iseggasen, issuter i baba-s ad t-yawi yesgall « ad yili d aɛdaw n wugdud aṛumani ticki i s-izmer ». Limin-agi, yettwagall zdat iyilluten n Qarṭaǧ, ad yeg talɣa n lḥal n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan i tsuta.
voices.title: Ayen d-qqaren Imezwura
voices.items.0.q: « Anezwi aḥṛic n umenɣi-agi, s tmusni akked tezmert n wul, d Hamilkar, yettusemman Barka. »
voices.items.1.q: « Ulac agellid i yemsaɛadal akked Épaminondas, Périclès, Thémistocle, Manius Curius neɣ Hamilkar Barka. »
voices.items.1.cite: Caton Amɣar, akken i d-yeqqar Plutarque, Tudert n Caton, 8
voices.items.2.q: Mi guɣal ɣer warraw-is mazal-iten d arrac, Hamilkar yeqqar-d belli yessaki-d ijujaḍ n yizmawen i uɣelli n tgelda taṛumanit.
voices.items.2.cite: Valère Maxime, Faits et dits mémorables, IX, 3
legacy.title: Baba-s n tririt
legacy.items.0.d: Lɛesker n ṣṣnaɛa, yettwaxdem di Sicile, di Afrika akked Hispanya, yeqqen ɣer twacult n Barka : allal n Kan.
legacy.items.1.d: Lmɛadin n nnuqra, tigallelt akked Iberiyen, timdinin timaynutin : umsagar i yesɛan Qarṭaǧ iwakken ad tnekker, i Hanibal iwakken ad yeddu ɣer Ṛuma.
legacy.items.2.d: Hanibal, Hasdrubal, Magun akked yiri-s Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ kemmlen tawuri-ines. Polybe yettwali deg zzɛaf-is yiwet seg ssababat n umenɣi apuni wis sin.
